findings.text: The AI row turns red even when the AI answered. `ux/Dictate/chat.js:195` compares `line.chat.at > watching_since` as text, but `watching_since` is UTC (`toISOString()`, "…Z") and Servex writes `chat.at` in local time with its offset (`Servex/agents/Sessions.js:103`, "…-05:00"). In Central time a real answer always sorts lower, so `health_answer` never fires, the row goes red after 60 s ("no answer…"), and a false line lands in `failures.jsonl`. It only works when a stream event comes first. The 1920 shot is green because the test stub writes UTC. Fix: compare `Date.parse()` values.

One ask in requirements.md is missing: "dictate on the website into the VS Code tab's session" (test cross-session messaging or the `UserPromptSubmit` fallback, run it once end to end, and write the result in the dictation doc). Neither the branch diff nor report.md mentions it, and the report does not list it as left open.

`review/diff.patch` is older than the branch. Commits 685633636 and 769696ad0 already fix the comments a scripted edit moved (diff lines `Mic.js` 105–107, `ErrorLog.js` 132–133, `AIPage.js` 279–280, `Widget.js` 817–818) and the stale tabs.md and sheet.md. Re-cut the diff before merging, so the merge reviews what will actually land.
`ext/ErrorLog/ErrorLog.js:133` (diff) writes `"failures" + ".jsonl"`, a split string with no reason given. If it dodges a hook or a grep, say which in a comment; if not, write it as one string.

`failures.jsonl` is git-ignored (`.gitignore:225`), but `ux/Dictate/readme.md`, `doc/debug-tab.md` and the Debug tab itself link to `/framework/ux/Dictate/failures.jsonl`. On the static site, or before the first failure, that link is a 404. Show "no failures yet" instead, or say in the link text that it is dev only.

`ext/Chat/Mic.js` `post_held` (diff line 95): when the 25 s backstop wins and the real send succeeds later, the sentence is both sent and copied into the fallback log, and the Sent row flips back to green. That is harmless, but the "not sent" event in the list is then wrong. The timer is also never cleared.

`shots/debug-390.png`: in the full sheet the chat thread takes the top half of the screen, mostly empty white below one bubble, so only 3 of the 5 layers fit above the fold. On a phone, Debug could get the space the empty thread uses.

Leaving the Debug tab after opening the page straight at `<page>/ai/debug/` replaces the url with the page's own url, not `<page>/ai/`, because `url_before` was never set (`ext/drawer/Sheet.js:411-415`, `route_tab`). A reload then follows `Sheet.routed()`, and with no `here` in `history.state` the sheet may come back closed. Falling back to `ai` instead of `about` keeps the sheet open.

The old name "dictation" is mapped to "debug" in four places: a hidden duplicate `VIEWS` row plus `HIDDEN` (`ext/drawer/AIPage.js:314-318`), `view_of` (`AIPage.js:325`), `SheetPanel.pick` (`Sheet.js:396`) and `DrawerTabs.open` (`tabs.js:506`). A simpler way: one alias, applied once where the url is read (`AIPage.old_link()` already rewrites `?drawer=dictation`). That would drop the hidden row and the `HIDDEN` set.

A failed send is written to the Sent row twice: by `chat.js` deliver's catch (`ux/Dictate/chat.js:1048` in the diff) and again by `ComposerMic.post_held`'s `.catch` (`ext/Chat/Mic.js:98`), which only runs if deliver throws (it never does). The Mic.js `.catch` is dead weight. It is harmless.

`ErrorLog.module_of` blames the first `/framework/…` file in the stack (`ext/ErrorLog/ErrorLog.js:159`). An uncaught error thrown inside a shared helper (`core/View`) is therefore logged to `core/View/failures.jsonl`, not to the page's module. That is fine for now, but the zero-errors board in `page-watcher.md` should group by `page` as well as by module.

`report.md` "Docs this made out of date" still lists `ext/drawer/doc/tabs.md` and `doc/sheet.md`, but the diff updates both. What is still stale: `ux/Dictate/surfaces/page.js` lists `tabs/dictation.js`, which no code loads now (dead file, keep or archive). Also `ext/drawer/readme.md:486` still says the AIPage views are "chat, live, sessions, dictation and settings".

In `shots/debug-390.png` the chat fills the top half and the Debug rows start below it, so the Sent and AI rows are under the fold at 390×844. The owner has to scroll to see the two rows that matter most for "the AI never answers". Showing Debug without the chat above it in the full sheet would put all five rows on one screen. In `shots/debug-390-reloaded.png` the same sentence and reply appear twice. That is most likely two test runs (one before the reload, one after), not a duplicate bubble, but worth one look.
